description: Retire one memory in favor of another: tombstone with a superseded_by pointer, never a plain delete. The consolidation seam; pinned memories cannot be superseded. reinforce makes it a merge (the non-pinned survivor absorbs the retired record's observations); reason is carried on the item-changed events.

bank.description: Bank; omitted: the calling session's bank, else the configured default.

reason.description: Why — carried on the `memory::item-changed` events this call emits (not persisted on the record). Trimmed, capped at 500 chars.

reinforce.description: Merge semantics: the survivor absorbs the retired record's observations (corroboration += retired + 1) in the same call. A pinned survivor is never written. Default false (a state change: the new record replaces the old, nothing to absorb).

Confidence.description: How a memory entered the store.

oneOf.description: Stated directly in the source conversation.
Derived by the extraction model rather than stated verbatim.
Saved explicitly by an agent or a human (highest trust).

Memory.description: One memory item. Serialized whole as a `memories.jsonl` line; replay is last-wins by `id`, so an update appends a full record with a bumped `revision` and a delete appends a tombstoned record (`invalid_at` set) — history is never destroyed, only superseded.

corroboration.description: Times this memory was independently re-observed. Boosts recall rank.

entities.description: Entity handles used as an exact-match retrieval signal.

id.description: Content fingerprint (`fp` + FNV-1a of the normalized text), so re-ingesting the same source reinforces instead of duplicating.

invalid_at.description: Set when the memory stopped being true (superseded or deleted). The record stays on disk and remains queryable with `include_superseded: true`.

pinned.description: Pinned memories are never touched by any automatic path (consolidation, decay); only an explicit `memory::pin`/`memory::update` changes them.

revision.description: Bumped on every appended revision of this id; replay keeps the highest.

stated_at.description: When the fact was last STATED (said, re-observed, text edited): an extracted memory takes its message's time, not the pass's. Unlike `updated_at`, pin/tag/entity edits never bump it, so recency, the shown date and "which statement is current" go by it. Legacy records load as None.

superseded_by.description: Memory id that replaced this one, when superseded by content.

tags.description: Topical labels for filtering WITHIN a bank ("iii", "workers", "billing") — organization, not ranking. Normalized lowercase, capped like entities. Old records without the field load as untagged.

Provenance.description: Where a memory came from. Every extracted memory points back into session-manager; nothing in memory duplicates the transcript store.

reinforced.description: True when the survivor was reinforced (`reinforce` asked and the survivor is not pinned).
